output: target/hdl-qualification/hdc/<UTC timestamp>-pid<PID>/receipt.json and hashed logs per module/architecture/width
pass_semantics: simulation_smoke_pass requires all 12 cases to lint, compile and execute with exit code zero and exact expected PASS marker.
fail_closed_semantics: missing required tool => unqualified_tool_missing and exit 2
failed lint/build/simulation or absent pass marker => failed non-pass
all per-case PASS records are needed for aggregate pass
receipts never imply formal proof, synthesis/PPA, FPGA observation, physical energy or SOTA
tool_versions: Provided by root flake.lock through devShells.hdl, subject to platform and lock file
status: specification only; all 12 RTL cases remain unexecuted because Verilator/Nix are unavailable on the authoring host
claim_ceiling: Word-level simulated correctness only. No vector accumulator/controller, synthesis/PPA, FPGA, ASIC, physical energy or product/SOTA qualification.
receipt_fields: hashes for RTL modules, testbenches, runner, manifest, schema, expected-case matrix, validator, flake.nix and flake.lock
exact Git HEAD and Verilator version
per-case ID, module, width, architecture, lint/build/simulation exit codes, pass-marker status
validation_protocol: run run_hdl_smoke.sh from the root pinned .#hdl dev shell
run validate_hdl_receipt.sh on the exact receipt and case matrix
the validator checks that all expected cases occur exactly once, all case results pass, and current source/configuration hashes and Git HEAD match the receipt
a changed source tree must not be used to retroactively validate a receipt from another revision
